records.text: Here is the article, which is available on the Idaho Attorney General's website. Not a lot of details beyond this. It just tells us that Attorney General Raul Labrador has announced that a Meridian man was charged in Idaho on March 5th, 2026 with four counts of enticing a child.
records.speaker: Candace Owens
